summary: Elevra Lithium Ltd filed a Form 6-K with exhibits announcing the issuance of a C$65 million upfront tranche of convertible notes to Canada Growth Fund Inc. under a previously announced financing package. The notes mature in five years, accrue interest at CORRA plus 225 basis points, and convert at A$17.17 per share. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation. Proceeds fund the NAL Brownfield Expansion. The conditional second tranche remains subject to conditions. No strategic review, acquisition, or corporate action is involved; thus, no special-situation classification applies.
